text:
nina_sales: ACME Ops wants a 'lift-and-merge' POC from CompetitorX -> Redwood. They need parity checks, cost comparison, and security answers. @omar_se can you run the tech lead?

omar_se: Happy to. Quick ask: which exact endpoints and a few production examples? We should get their top 50 prompts for parity eval.

zara_client: We'll share a scrubbed prompt set + 2 sample request traces. Primary calls: /v1/chat and /v1/completions. Peak ~150 rps, avg token length ~450. Sending artifacts to your email.

infra-bot: staging org created: acme-poc-staging (keys exp 10 days).

omar_se: POC plan sketch: 1) ingest prompt corpus & map to Redwood models. 2) run side-by-side smoke (1000 samples) and record diffs. 3) tune batching/kv-cache and rerun perf. Deliverable: parity report + diff log.

tara_security: Security needs completed questionnaire, data flow diagram, and any egress IPs. If they have KMS requirements, send details now. Turnaround ~72h after we get docs.

felix_product: Mapping note: CompetitorX "fast-gen" approx maps to rwd-fast-1; expect slightly different stop-token behavior. We'll add a small normalization layer in the POC to reduce surface diffs.

nina_sales: Pricing question: they asked for committed 6mo pricing vs PAYG. What's the quick band?

omar_se: Also, they requested functional parity on system messages and assistant role handling. We'll include a few system-message tests.

felix_product: Ballpark discount bands: 20-30% for 6mo depending on qps. For Dedicated reserved capacity we can offer custom pricing.

zara_client: Can you deliver a draft SOW by Thursday? Security will start questionnaire on Wednesday.

nina_sales: Action items: Omar to produce 1-pg POC plan + mapping by EOD tomorrow, Tara to confirm security SLA, Felix to note model mapping, I will draft SOW. Sync Fri 9am PT.

(reacts: :white_check_mark:, :chart_with_upwards_trend:)
